speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your symptoms in detail, specifically regarding the blisters on your forearm and the ulcers on your mucosal surfaces, and when they first appeared. REQUEST TEST: Blood work including CBC, ESR, CRP, ANA, and HIV status.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CBC: Within normal limits; Autoantibodies: Presence of desmoglein antibodies; Skin Biopsy: Acantholysis and intraepidermal blister formation; Direct Immunofluorescence: Intercellular IgG and C3 deposition within the epidermis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pemphigus Vulgaris. The combination of desmoglein antibodies, acantholysis on biopsy, and intercellular IgG/C3 deposition confirms this autoimmune mucocutaneous blistering disease.
